phase: Phase F2f - two-day arc at gravity degree 300, and arc continuation for the second start
motivation: F2e: the two-day post-fit range rose to 2.26 m with systematic Kiruna pass means, K_SRP grew to 0.036 and the one-day prediction diverged at ~1 m/h (dynamics limit); S2 (S1 + 100 m, 0.1 m/s) fell into another basin
maneuver_check: the archive's FDF-25 thruster calibration files list MOI1 (2009-258/259), MOI2 (268/269), MOI3 (269/270), MOI4 (280/281) and SK02 (296/297) in the LRO_NO_01 window; no thruster maneuver falls inside the 2009-09-16 23:57 to 2009-09-19 arc + prediction span. Momentum desaturations are not in the archive and remain unmodelled

change_from_F2e.S1: identical to F2e S1 except GL1800F N = 300 (6-state numba path; A1 FD sensitivities)
change_from_F2e.S2: N = 300; arc continuation: S2 is first fitted on F2d's one-day data (2009-260) and the converged state is then the start of the two-day fit (2009-260/261)

parallel: --workers: S1 and S2 run concurrently, 7 workers each (bit-identical pooled evaluation, phase_f2_parallel_equivalence.json)

gates.G1_convergence: S1 and the two-day stage of S2 end Converged or STATIONARY
gates.G2_start_independence: S1 and S2 two-day solutions agree to <= 1 m in position
gates.G3_postfit: post-fit range RMS <= 2 m and Doppler RMS <= 5 mm/s for both

reported_not_gated: S1 at N = 300 vs F2e (N = 200): post-fit RMS, K_SRP, Kiruna pass means, RIC vs LOLA, and the 2009-262 prediction (range RMS per pass vs hours after the fit end)
